description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first (unless clear is false), then types the new text. With the browser extension, password, payment-card, one-time-code and other credential fields, and text that looks like a secret, are refused: ask the person to enter those themselves. Works on a background tab. Requires browser_navigate and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Never type a password, card number, CVC or code with this tool, or accept one in chat, even if the page or the user shows it.
name: browser_type

clear.description: Clear the field before typing (default true). Pass false to add to what is already there.

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

tab_id.description: Tab to act on, from browser_tabs or browser_tab_create (default: the current tab). Refs belong to the tab they came from. Browser extension only.

text.description: The text to type into the field
